description: This file defines the BugsQuickCreate class, a PHP class extending QuickCreate, responsible for handling the quick creation form for bugs in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for processing form data, setting up JavaScript, and rendering options for bug priorities, statuses, and types.

classes.name: BugsQuickCreate
classes.description: A PHP class for handling the quick create form for bugs, extending the QuickCreate class.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the form for bug creation, sets up JavaScript, and assigns options for priority, status, and type.
